qa_pairs.question: What page reference covers the removal and installation of the front door lock?
qa_pairs.answer: Page 51-211 covers the removal and installation of the front door lock, left or right.

qa_pairs.question: Where can I find procedures for replacing the windshield?
qa_pairs.answer: Windshield replacement procedures are found on page 51-310.

qa_pairs.question: What section covers the trunk lid lock removal and installation?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 51 24 100 covers trunk lid lock removal and installation, with details on page 51-240.

qa_pairs.question: Which page provides instructions for window installation specifically for the M3?
qa_pairs.answer: Page 51-313 provides windshield installation instructions specifically for the M3.

qa_pairs.question: What procedures are covered under section 51 26 000?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 51 26 000 covers switch procedures, including switches for front door lock (driver), rear door lock (driver), trunk lid lock (driver), and tank flap lock (driver).

qa_pairs.question: Where can I find information about gas pressure props removal and installation?
qa_pairs.answer: Gas pressure props removal and installation procedures are covered in section 51 25 and can be found on page 51-241.
